title: Emrys and the Letters
author: Bram Halloran
blurb: Ivo Oyelaran, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
